anya_dev: heads-up — hit an ssl verify error using the Python async SDK against a Dedicated VPC host behind a local HTTP proxy + custom CA. curl + --cacert succeeds but our async sample (httpx) fails. :grimacing:

anya_dev: minimal repro (async):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.vpc:8443', api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
await client.chat.create('yo')
```

anya_dev: container has /etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem mounted. `curl --cacert /etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem https://dedicated.vpc:8443/health` -> 200, but httpx raises `ssl.SSLError: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED`.

sam_sdk: likely interaction between httpx trust_env and proxy interception. httpx will pick up HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE via trust_env. If the proxy re-TLSes, verify fails unless your client uses the proxy's CA.

sam_sdk: quick actionable workaround:
```py
import ssl
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ssl_ctx.load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated.vpc:8443', api_key=..., ssl=ssl_ctx, trust_env=False)
```

anya_dev: that fixed it. two follow-ups: (1) docs/examples don't show ssl or trust_env usage for async flows, (2) our retry layer retries on SSLError which made the logs noisy (backoff logs + masked root cause).

ela_docs: good catch. onboarding only covers base_url + token. I'll add a short "Dedicated/Private: proxy + custom CA (async)" note with the exact snippet and a tiny docker-compose example under examples/dedicated/vpc-proxy-ca-sample. include environment vars: HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and a note: "httpx respects trust_env, set trust_env=False or pass ssl context."

mike_sre: on retries — agree we should not retry verification failures. I'll open an issue to change the retry predicate to exclude ssl.SSLError subclasses raised during verification (and log as non-retryable). Also FYI for infra: envoy/sidecar + HTTP_PROXY combos are particularly flaky; mounting the CA and using explicit SSLContext is the pragmatic fix.

sam_sdk: small SDK changes I'll push: (a) accept ssl: Optional[ssl.SSLContext] arg in AsyncClient ctor and expose it in .pyi stubs, (b) type __aenter__ to return the concrete AsyncClient type so context manager use is typed, (c) add unit test that mocks an ssl.SSLError and asserts zero retries.

anya_dev: I'll open the docs PR and attach the tiny example + both the httpx stack trace and the successful curl output. will reference env vars and mention REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE vs custom loaded SSLContext behavior.
